verdict.rationale: Letta is itself an agent product: users hand tasks to stateful agents through the web, desktop, CLI and Slack apps. The docs show those agents doing real work, such as sweeping bug reports, opening pull requests, running scheduled prompts, running headless, and spawning subagents to divide and conquer tasks. Community posts from Letta staff describe Letta Code as long-lived agents that build context over time. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation outcomes.
